biological_interpretation: Mature cortical Ski loss acts through a restricted neuronal regulon rather than simply derepressing a generic SMAD/TGF-beta program.
caveats: Cell counts and target-transcript knockdown differ by class; the thalamic response contains only two FDR genes.
The DE table cannot distinguish true biological buffering from poor guide activity or sparse target expression; protein-level perturbation was not measured.
The Smad2 signature was weak, which compresses all correlation estimates; comparisons were transcriptomic and not phospho-SMAD assays.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Partial Ski perturbation yielded a mixed, FDR-supported neuronal RNA phenotype dominated by L2/3 IT CTX Glut markers including Wscd2, Chd3, Rfx3, Pde4a, Plk5, Ttyh3, and Acsl3, whereas Tgif1, Smad2, and receptor-level TGF-beta perturbations did not recapitulate a canonical SMAD module. Parquet-verified leading rows: Ski->Wscd2 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC 0.656, FDR 9.42e-04; Ski->Chd3 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC 0.546, FDR 0.00297; Ski->Rfx3 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC 0.567, FDR 0.00402; Ski->Begain in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC 0.388, FDR 0.00712; Ski->Pde4a in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC 0.66, FDR 0.00813; Ski->Slc27a1 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC 0.601, FDR 0.00813.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.direction: cell-type-restricted positive and mixed transcriptional response
finding_summaries.summary: Adjusted-significant Ski responses are concentrated in L2/3 intratelencephalic cortical glutamatergic neurons, with only a two-gene secondary response in TH Prkcd Grin2c glutamatergic neurons.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The perturbation is not a uniform neuronal TGF-beta/SMAD phenotype; most interpretable downstream signal comes from a single cortical IT class.

finding_summaries.summary: Tgif1 targeting produced no FDR-significant transcriptomic response and no significant target-transcript depletion in any of 23 assayed mouse-brain cell types.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: TGIF1 is a transcriptional corepressor, so the absence of a DE program primarily argues that Tgif1 was unengaged, redundant, or not rate-limiting in these assays rather than revealing a strong TGIF1-regulated state.

finding_summaries.summary: Smad2 signatures were nearly orthogonal to perturbations of curated SMAD2 complex members, receptors, and transcriptional repressors, and unbiased nearest neighbors were also weak.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: Physical or pathway proximity to SMAD2 did not imply exchangeable CRISPR transcriptomes in these neuronal classes, preventing the Smad2 hit list from being generalized to the TGFβ receptor module.

resolved_evidence.description: The strongest cell-type-specific Ski perturbation signature.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 123 perturbed cells versus 7553 controls; 14 genes at FDR<0.05. Top adjusted hits: Wscd2 logFC 0.656 FDR 9.42e-4, Chd3 0.546 FDR 0.00297, Rfx3 0.567 FDR 0.00402, Begain 0.388 FDR 0.00712; downregulated FDR hits included Plk5 logFC -1.131 FDR 0.0198, Ttyh3 -0.380 FDR 0.0340, and Acsl3 -0.477 FDR 0.0384.

resolved_evidence.description: A sparse but adjusted-significant Ski response in thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic neurons.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 335 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; only Cck logFC 0.212 FDR 0.00675 and L1cam logFC 0.140 FDR 0.0277 reached FDR<0.05; the next gene Spock2 had FDR 0.0801.

resolved_evidence.description: Global distribution of adjusted-significant differential expression after Ski perturbation.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Across the 23 Ski signatures, 16 total rows passed FDR<0.05: 14 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, 2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, and 0 in each of the other 21 cell types.

resolved_evidence.description: The measured Tgif1 target transcript did not provide statistical evidence of transcript knockdown in any assayed cell type.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 23/23 cell types; 388,046 Tgif1 DE rows; 21-217 Tgif1-targeting cells versus 2,019-23,679 matched controls. The Tgif1 transcript row had scores from -0.074 to 0.426, nominal p values from 0.670 to 0.993, and FDR=1.0 in every cell type.

resolved_evidence.description: Tgif1 perturbation produced no conventionally significant differential-expression hit after multiple-testing correction.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 0/388,046 rows had pvals_adj<0.05. Best adjusted values: Dusp7 in 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut, score -4.409, p=1.04e-5, FDR=0.177; Nop10 in 155 MB Glut, score 4.296, p=1.74e-5, FDR=0.304; Zfp106 in 191 MB P MY GABA, score -4.180, p=2.92e-5, FDR=0.500; Wdr3 in 308 CB GABA, score 4.146, p=3.43e-5, FDR=0.573.

resolved_evidence.description: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut contained the lowest adjusted p value in the entire Tgif1 subset, but it was still not FDR-significant.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 95 perturbed cells versus 8,620 controls; Dusp7 logFC -0.898, score -4.409, p=1.04e-5, FDR=0.177.

resolved_evidence.description: Two of the largest Tgif1 cell-type contrasts remained negative after FDR correction.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: 217 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls, min FDR=1.0, best nominal Yars p=2.06e-4, Tgif1 p=0.843. 155 MB Glut: 213 perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls, min FDR=0.304 at Nop10 p=1.74e-5, Tgif1 p=0.838.

resolved_evidence.description: Smad2 signatures were not linearly similar to close pathway-neighbor perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Pearson correlations of full score vectors were computed between Smad2 and 19 TGFβ/BMP-related perturbations in each of 21 matched cell types. Mean correlations were Smad3 0.004, Smad4 0.010, Tgfbr1 0.007, Tgfbr2 0.015, Acvr2a -0.0001, Acvr2b 0.019, Ski -0.006, and Tgif1 0.011; the largest absolute correlation among all 399 comparisons was 0.174.

resolved_evidence.description: The two Smad2 FDR hits were not FDR-significant downstream of nearby pathway perturbations in the same cell classes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: In 155 MB Glut, no queried related TGFβ/BMP perturbation changed Ache at FDR<0.05; the smallest nominal p was Tgfbr2 with score 2.634, logFC 0.105, p=0.00843, FDR=1.0. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, no related perturbation changed Cpne7 at FDR<0.05; the smallest nominal p was Tgif1 with score -3.254, logFC -0.154, p=0.00114, FDR=1.0.

resolved_evidence.description: Unbiased perturbation neighbors did not define a strong Smad2-like or anti-Smad2-like module.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Genome-wide Pearson nearest-neighbor correlations were weak in the two FDR-positive Smad2 classes: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, top positive Xpo1 r=0.100 and top negative Chp1 r=-0.122; in 155 MB Glut, top positive Ywhae r=0.075 and top negative Esrrg r=-0.051.

title: Ski loss exposes a narrow L2/3 intratelencephalic cortical marker program instead of a broad TGF-beta/SMAD response
